choice:36:1:2.female: You might be even smarter than me!

choice:31:0:1.text: Once we know what caused the echo, we can release it.
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 这能帮助我们破除幽灵的执念
choice:31:0:1.male: Once we know what caused the echo, we can release it.
choice:31:0:1.female: Once we know what caused the echo, we can release it.

choice:27:0:1.text: An echo is triggered when it senses an obsession nearby.
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 回声似乎会被某种“执念”触发
choice:27:0:1.male: An echo is triggered when it senses an obsession nearby.
choice:27:0:1.female: An echo is triggered when it senses an obsession nearby.

say:43:1620615011:0.text: I knew it! It's a ghost! We're doomed! We're gonna get dragged into the underworld!
say:43:1620615011:0.source_cn: 啊！果然是幽灵！完了完了，我们要被拖走了……！

say:0:1620616001:0.text: The magic coming off this crucible feels similar to that wand from earlier...
say:0:1620616001:0.source_cn: 这个坩埚散发的魔力，跟刚才的魔杖类似……
say:0:1620616001:0.male: The magic coming off this crucible feels similar to that wand from earlier...
say:0:1620616001:0.female: The magic coming off this crucible feels similar to that wand from earlier...

say:0:1620617001:1.text: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.
say:0:1620617001:1.source_cn: 你们又看到了那个苍白的身影，他低垂着头，空气中弥漫着无...
say:0:1620617001:1.male: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.
say:0:1620617001:1.female: The pale figure appears again. His head is bowed, and the air around him feels heavy, like the room itself is grieving.

say:1:1620617002:0.text: A faint voice echoes, like a piece of memory from the past.
say:1:1620617002:0.source_cn: 声音幽幽地回荡，像是从遥远的过去透出的一段断裂记忆。

say:4:1620617004:0.text: <style="highlight">"I just wanted my students to master magic... but I never saw how far they were being pushed..."</style>

say:5:1620617005:0.text: <style="highlight">"I wasn't teaching. I was driving them toward disaster..."</style>

say:7:1620617006:0.text: This time, the echo isn't angry. It sounds low and weak, filled with regret and sorrow.
say:7:1620617006:0.source_cn: 相比刚才的训斥，这段回声低沉而无力，仿佛夹杂着无尽的悔...

say:9:1620617007:0.text: He was shouting just a moment ago, and now... he sounds so sad.
say:9:1620617007:0.source_cn: 刚才还在训斥呢，怎么一转眼就变成这样了？

say:10:1620617008:0.text: An echo is only a fragment of memory. A moment from the past, frozen in magic.
say:10:1620617008:0.source_cn: 回声不过是魔力形成的残影，你可以理解为过去发生过的一个片段。

say:11:1620617009:0.text: That makes sense... we just don't know what happened between those moments.
say:11:1620617009:0.source_cn: 也对，只是我们不清楚这中间发生了什么。

say:12:1620617010:0.text: Honestly... when he was shouting earlier, I just thought he was another strict, cold professor with anger issues.
say:12:1620617010:0.source_cn: 不过……刚才么凶巴巴的，我还以为是那种不近人情的严厉老师呢。

say:13:1620617011:0.text: Yeah... I'm not sure what to think anymore.

choice_prompt:14:1620617011.text: Yeah... I'm not sure what to think anymore.

say:15:1620617012:0.text: I used to think an echo came from just one strong emotion, like anger or guilt. But this one... this is more than that.
say:15:1620617012:0.source_cn: 我也是这么想的，不过我一直以为执念只是单一的情绪，但这...

say:16:1620617013:0.text: Either way, we should keep going. We might never get another chance to study something like this up close.
say:16:1620617013:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我们得继续调查，这可是难得的学习机会。

say:17:1620617014:0.text: That's so like you, Loran. Everyone else is scared, and you're thinking about what we can learn from it.
say:17:1620617014:0.source_cn: 不愧是你，洛兰，这种时候还想着学习。

say:18:1620617015:0.text: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.
say:18:1620617015:0.male: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.
say:18:1620617015:0.female: Naturally. Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's keep going. We're right behind you.

choice:14:0:1.text: It could be the key to releasing the echo.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 这也许是破除执念的关键
choice:14:0:1.male: It could be the key to releasing the echo.
choice:14:0:1.female: It could be the key to releasing the echo.

say:0:1620618001:0.text: Huh? Is that a notebook over there?

say:1:1620619001:0.text: ... He's been through a lot, hasn't he?
say:1:1620619001:0.source_cn: 唉……这位老师的经历真够坎坷的。

say:2:1620619002:0.text: I think he meant well. He just went too far trying to make sure his students succeeded.
say:2:1620619002:0.source_cn: 也许他只是想让学生有个好未来，只是……方法粗暴了点。

say:3:1620619003:0.text: Went too far? What makes you say that?
say:3:1620619003:0.source_cn: 粗暴？为什么你们会这么觉得？

say:4:1620619004:0.text: Didn't you hear what he said? He's clearly full of regret. He knows he pushed too hard.
say:4:1620619004:0.source_cn: 当然啊，就连他自己，不也这么承认了吗？

say:5:1620619005:0.text: But isn't it a professor's job to push their students? To challenge them?
say:5:1620619005:0.source_cn: 我不太明白。难道督促学生，不正是老师的职责吗？

say:6:1620619006:0.text: That's just it, Loran. Can I ask you something? Why did you want to become a mage in the first place?
say:6:1620619006:0.source_cn: 啧啧，洛兰，其实我一直想问——你是为了什么才想当魔法师的？

say:8:1620619008:0.text: There's always a reason. You don't study magic for no reason, just like you don't eat for no reason.
say:8:1620619008:0.source_cn: 当然得有个理由吧，就像饿了会吃饭，渴了会喝水一样。

say:10:1620619010:0.text: For me, it started with an old mage in my village.
say:10:1620619010:0.source_cn: 比如说，我的魔法启蒙，是镇上的一位魔法师老奶奶教的。

say:11:1620619011:0.text: The town had constant droughts, but her magic always brought gentle rain. She saved the crops, year after year.
say:11:1620619011:0.source_cn: 那会儿我们镇老是闹旱灾，她的魔法总能带来温润的小雨，救...

say:12:1620619012:0.text: What truly lit that fire in me was something she once said: <style="highlight">"Magic is just a tool. It sparks hope, and carries it forward."</style>
say:12:1620619012:0.source_cn: 让我真正对魔法燃起兴趣的，是她对我说的——<style...

say:13:1620619013:0.text: Ever since then, I've been learning water magic, hoping that one day, I can help others like she did.
say:13:1620619013:0.source_cn: 就因为这句话，我才一直坚持学水魔法，希望有一天能像她那...

say:14:1620619014:0.text: That's why I study. Knowledge has to serve a purpose. Without that, all those theories don't mean a thing.
say:14:1620619014:0.source_cn: 所以学术对我来说是为了实现目标而存在的，不然就是本末倒置。

say:15:1620619015:0.text: I've never thought about it that way. I just enjoy learning. I never asked myself what for.
say:15:1620619015:0.source_cn: 我从未想过这些……我只是喜欢研究学术，从没想过要用它干什么。

say:17:1620619016:0.text: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.
say:17:1620619016:0.source_cn: 洛兰话音未落，楼道深处忽然传来一阵急促的扑翼声。
say:17:1620619016:0.male: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.
say:17:1620619016:0.female: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.

say:18:1620619017:0.text: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.
say:18:1620619017:0.source_cn: 无数魔法书从阴影中冲出，像潮水般扑向你们——
say:18:1620619017:0.male: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.
say:18:1620619017:0.female: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.

say:19:1620619018:0.text: The books... there's so many! They've gone completely mad!
say:19:1620619018:0.source_cn: 一大群魔法书！它们发疯了！

say:0:1620620001:0.text: Could the echo's magic still be active? Is that what's attracting them?
say:0:1620620001:0.source_cn: 魔法书没有散去……难道是被这个回声的魔力吸引？
say:0:1620620001:0.male: Could the echo's magic still be active? Is that what's attracting them?
say:0:1620620001:0.female: Could the echo's magic still be active? Is that what's attracting them?

say:2:1620621002:0.text: A voice speaks—low, hoarse, barely holding together. Some words come through clearly, others get lost in the air, as if torn by the wind.
say:2:1620621002:0.source_cn: 他的嗓音低哑，仿佛久未开口，声线断断续续，时而清晰，时...

say:3:1620621003:0.text: It's been so long... since anyone came to my class...
say:3:1620621003:0.source_cn: 很久……没人来上我的课了……
say:3:1620621003:0.male: It's been so long... since anyone came to my class...
say:3:1620621003:0.female: It's been so long... since anyone came to my class...

say:4:1620621004:0.text: For years, no one at the Lyceum had enough magic power to notice me... You're the first to stir me from slumber.
say:4:1620621004:0.source_cn: 多少年来，莱希拉姆鲜有人拥有足够的魔力察觉到我的存在…...
say:4:1620621004:0.male: For years, no one at the Lyceum had enough magic power to notice me... You're the first to stir me from slumber.
say:4:1620621004:0.female: For years, no one at the Lyceum had enough magic power to notice me... You're the first to stir me from slumber.

say:5:1620621005:0.text: Ah... Ancestral Sense. No wonder. You must be a talented young mage.
say:5:1620621005:0.source_cn: 噢……变形术先祖感应能力，怪不得可以感应到我，看来是位...
say:5:1620621005:0.male: Ah... Ancestral Sense. No wonder. You must be a talented young mage.
say:5:1620621005:0.female: Ah... Ancestral Sense. No wonder. You must be a talented young mage.

say:6:1620621006:0.text: Tell me... is there anything I can do for you?
say:6:1620621006:0.source_cn: 有什么……我能为你们做的吗……？

choice_prompt:7:1620621006.text: Tell me... is there anything I can do for you?
choice_prompt:7:1620621006.source_cn: 有什么……我能为你们做的吗……？

say:8:1620621007:0.text: I see... That was never my intention.

say:10:1620621009:0.text: What... what are you? A ghost? Something else?
say:10:1620621009:0.source_cn: 你……你到底是幽灵，还是什么！

say:11:1620621010:0.text: You don't need to fear me, young mage. Whatever I may be now, I promise you this: I mean you no harm.
say:11:1620621010:0.source_cn: 年轻的魔法师啊，别怕。无论我是什么，我都向你们保证——...

say:12:1620621011:0.text: I know the echoes have been troubling. I've been trying to silence them... to erase the remnants I left behind.
say:12:1620621011:0.source_cn: 我知道，那些魔法回声确实打扰了这里的学生。事实上……我...

say:13:1620621012:0.text: I thought time would fix everything. That eventually, they would fade away on their own, and take me with them.
say:13:1620621012:0.source_cn: 我原以为随着岁月流逝，那些回声的魔力早已衰退，不复存在。

say:14:1620621013:0.text: But for some reason, the echoes started appearing again. They attracted the magic books, and... woke me up too.
say:14:1620621013:0.source_cn: 可不知为什么，它们竟再次回荡在这里，于是那些魔法书被吸...

say:15:1620621014:1.text: You didn't bring the echoes back on purpose, right? You're not trying to take us away?
say:15:1620621014:1.source_cn: 不、不会是你故意激活的吧，然后把我们全部带走……

say:16:1620621015:0.text: Take you away? No. I don't have the power to do anything like that.
say:16:1620621015:0.source_cn: 带走你们？不，我并没有那样的力量。

say:17:1620621016:0.text: Anyway, we need to understand what's happening.
say:17:1620621016:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我觉得梳理一下现状比较好。

say:18:1620621017:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, earlier you said an echo like this can be released. Do you know how to do it?
say:18:1620621017:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, earlier you said an echo like this can be released. Do you know how to do it?
say:18:1620621017:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, earlier you said an echo like this can be released. Do you know how to do it?

say:22:1620621020:0.text: It contained my last confession. But no, if I think about it now, the echoes might react. They might get stronger!
say:22:1620621020:0.source_cn: 那是我最后的忏悔……不！我不能回忆这些，否则那些回声又...

say:25:1620621025:0.text: He lets out another long, tired sigh. Then a heavy silence follows.
say:25:1620621025:0.source_cn: 又是一声悠长的哀叹，随之而来的，是漫长而沉重的沉默。

say:26:1620621026:0.text: What happened? Why isn't he saying anything?
say:26:1620621026:0.source_cn: 怎么回事？他怎么不说话了？

choice:20:0:1.text: Do you remember something about a journal?
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 你还记得关于日记的事吗？
choice:20:0:1.male: Do you remember something about a journal?
choice:20:0:1.female: Do you remember something about a journal?

say:28:1620621022:0.text: There are so many pieces of my past still left here...
say:28:1620621022:0.source_cn: 记忆……这里有太多我的回声……

say:29:1620621023:0.text: Give me a moment. I need to think.
say:29:1620621023:0.source_cn: 抱歉……我必须好好回忆一下。

choice:20:1:2.text: Tell us about the memories behind those echoes.
choice:20:1:2.male: Tell us about the memories behind those echoes.
choice:20:1:2.female: Tell us about the memories behind those echoes.

say:30:1620621008:0.text: Help... Yes. Perhaps I do need help.
say:30:1620621008:0.source_cn: 帮我……也许我的确需要帮助。

say:0:1620622001:0.text: He's just standing there. Should we say something first?
say:0:1620622001:0.source_cn: 他不动了，我们叫他一下？

say:3:1620623002:1.text: If that's what you need to hear, then I'll tell you.
say:3:1620623002:1.source_cn: 我的过去……如果必须回忆的话，就和你们讲讲吧。

say:4:1620623003:0.text: I spent my whole youth studying. After I graduated, I stayed at the Lyceum as a professor, and I took pride in it.
say:4:1620623003:0.source_cn: 我的青春全都献给了学术，毕业后顺理成章成为一名老师。我...

say:5:1620623004:0.text: I told myself I wanted to be a good professor. But before I even understood what that meant, things started to go off track.
say:5:1620623004:0.source_cn: 也是从那一刻起，我立志要成为一名好老师……可还没等我这...

say:6:1620623005:0.text: Most of us here at the Lyceum weren't famous or brilliant. Just scholars who loved magic, always living in the shadow of legends like Merlin or Cyran.
say:6:1620623005:0.source_cn: 留在莱希拉姆的大多数老师，不过是痴迷学术的凡人，根本无...
say:6:1620623005:0.male: Most of us here at the Lyceum weren't famous or brilliant. Just scholars who loved magic, always living in the shadow of legends like Merlin or Cyran.
say:6:1620623005:0.female: Most of us here at the Lyceum weren't famous or brilliant. Just scholars who loved magic, always living in the shadow of legends like Merlin or Cyran.

say:7:1620623006:0.text: So for professors like us, our worth was judged entirely by how our students performed.
say:7:1620623006:0.source_cn: 所以……学生的成绩，就成了我们这些普通老师的全部。

say:8:1620623007:1.text: I wasn't always strict. But the more I chased "performance", the more I started to change...
say:8:1620623007:1.source_cn: 于是，曾经内敛温和的我，为了成绩，渐渐变成了严苛的“好...
say:8:1620623007:1.male: I wasn't always strict. But the more I chased "performance", the more I started to change...
say:8:1620623007:1.female: I wasn't always strict. But the more I chased "performance", the more I started to change...

say:9:1620623008:1.text: To be honest, when I look back now, I barely recognize the person I became.
say:9:1620623008:1.source_cn: 老实说，如今回望那时的自己，我几乎觉得那是个陌生人。

choice_prompt:10:1620623008.text: To be honest, when I look back now, I barely recognize the person I became.
choice_prompt:10:1620623008.source_cn: 老实说，如今回望那时的自己，我几乎觉得那是个陌生人。

say:11:1620623009:1.text: The real me...? Maybe you're right. I wasn't always like that.
say:11:1620623009:1.source_cn: 真实的……我……？也许你说得对，本来的我并不是这样的。

say:12:1620623012:1.text: I dedicated the rest of my life to teaching, hoping to do better.
say:12:1620623012:1.source_cn: 而我接下来的余生……都奉献给了教育事业。

say:13:1620623013:0.text: But I can't undo what's been done. My harshness hurt them.
say:13:1620623013:0.source_cn: 可我的严苛，却给学生们带来了不可逆的压力……这是我最大...

say:16:1620623015:1.text: That's kind of you to say... Thank you.
say:16:1620623015:1.source_cn: 你的话让人感到温暖……谢谢你。
say:16:1620623015:1.male: That's kind of you to say... Thank you.
say:16:1620623015:1.female: That's kind of you to say... Thank you.

say:17:1620623016:1.text: But I wonder... if my students were here, would they agree?
say:17:1620623016:1.source_cn: 但我的学生们，又会怎么想呢？

say:18:1620623018:0.text: One of my brightest students collapsed under the pressure I'd put on them. That was the moment I realized I had gone too far.
say:18:1620623018:0.source_cn: 我曾经最好的学生，因为压力而昏厥，那一刻我才意识到自己...

say:20:1620623019:0.text: You know... I'm not so sure that student fainted just from pressure.
say:20:1620623019:0.source_cn: 我倒觉得……那位昏厥的学生，不一定是因为压力。

say:21:1620623020:1.text: Some people are just wired that way—always pushing themselves to study harder. Like me, I'll skip meals and sleep if I'm deep in a magic problem.
say:21:1620623020:1.source_cn: 有些人天生就热爱学术……比如我，我经常废寝忘食地研究魔法。

say:22:1620623021:1.text: Yep, we've seen it. I wouldn't be shocked if you passed out one day in the middle of a sentence with a book in your hands.
say:22:1620623021:1.source_cn: 是啊，这我知道。你这种为了学习连饭都忘吃的人……哪天真...

say:23:1620623022:1.text: So... you think it wasn't the pressure?

say:24:1620623023:1.text: Yeah. You were the same once, weren't you, Professor? That kind of obsession, where nothing matters except study.
say:24:1620623023:1.source_cn: 是的。老师，你也是热爱学术的人，应该能理解那种狂热的感觉吧？

say:25:1620623024:1.text: I was. I know what that feels like.

choice_prompt:26:1620623024.text: I was. I know what that feels like.

say:28:1620623026:1.text: Yeah! Youth isn't about how old you are. It's about pushing through failure, trying again, breaking through. I live for that feeling!
say:28:1620623026:1.source_cn: 没错！与年龄无关，青春是个人的浪漫，不断地碰壁与突破，...

say:29:1620623029:1.text: One wants to be a great professor, the other a top student... If I had to guess, Loran, you're the one who triggered the echo!
say:29:1620623029:1.source_cn: 一个想当好老师，一个想当好学生……我斗胆猜测一下，回声...

say:30:1620623030:1.text: Me? You think it was me?

say:31:1620623031:1.text: Who else? You've been holed up in that study room for days.
say:31:1620623031:1.source_cn: 还能有谁？你在自习室连夜待了多少天了。

say:32:1620623032:1.text: I kept telling you to take breaks, but you wouldn't listen. You spent all your waking hours on those questions like nothing else mattered. That's what "obsession" looks like.
say:32:1620623032:1.source_cn: 我劝过你多少次，可你为了解开那几道题还是一头钻回去……...

say:33:1620623033:1.text: He's right... I see something in you that reminds me of myself. That same drive to push forward... and that lost feeling that comes with it.
say:33:1620623033:1.source_cn: 的确……我在你身上感受到了一种和我相似的情感。执着，还...

say:34:1620623034:1.text: For a mage, that's a dangerous mix. If you don't find a way to handle it, you might end up making the same mistakes I did.
say:34:1620623034:1.source_cn: 对魔法师来说，这是危险的。如果不妥当处理，你很可能会走...

say:35:1620623035:1.text: So you're saying Loran's gonna end up haunting the school too? Forever stuck in the study room, buried in textbooks?
say:35:1620623035:1.source_cn: 哈哈，也就是说，最后洛兰也会成为教学楼的幽灵吗？总会回...

say:36:1620623036:1.text: Banksee! Maybe don't say stuff like that right in front of the professor?
say:36:1620623036:1.source_cn: 班克西，你当着莫温老师的面这样讲话是不是有点无礼了……

say:37:1620623037:1.text: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean anything by it.

say:38:1620623038:1.text: It's all right. And he's not wrong. If you keep bottling up what's really driving you... it'll leave a mark eventually.
say:38:1620623038:1.source_cn: 没关系的，并且说的也没错……如果你不正视你自己的内心，...

say:39:1620623039:1.text: I understand your dedication, Loran. But what is it that's making you feel lost?
say:39:1620623039:1.source_cn: 洛兰，你的执着我能理解，但你眼中的迷茫是什么呢……

say:40:1620623040:1.text: Professor... I've just been wondering, someone like me, who's completely wrapped up in research... what kind of mage could I even become? Lately... I'm not sure anymore.
say:40:1620623040:1.source_cn: 老师……我……其实在想，像我这样沉迷学术的人，将来能成...

say:41:1620623041:1.text: Feeling unsure just means you've started looking for your own path forward.
say:41:1620623041:1.source_cn: 迷茫，意味着你开始在更广阔的天空中寻找自己的航向。

say:42:1620623042:1.text: I used to think like you—that academic study was everything. But I eventually realized: knowledge is just a tool. It's how you use it that defines a mage.
say:42:1620623042:1.source_cn: 我曾和你一样，以为学术是唯一的道路。但后来发现，知识本...

say:43:1620623043:1.text: Maybe you'll teach one day, pass your knowledge on and help others grow. Or join the Evergreen Conservatory and dive deep into a field of your own. Or put your knowledge to work, curing illness, protecting cities... doing real good in the world.
say:43:1620623043:1.source_cn: 或许，你可以成为一名教师，将智慧的种子播撒出去。或许，...

say:44:1620623044:1.text: What matters most is this: don't rush to pick a single "correct" path. Take time to see what knowledge can really do, and all the possibilities it can open up.
say:44:1620623044:1.source_cn: 关键在于，不要急于找到“唯一答案”，而是先看清知识所能...

say:45:1620623045:1.text: All the possibilities? I think I get what you mean. I'll take some time to really think it through.
say:45:1620623045:1.source_cn: 各种……可能？我好像明白一点了。我会好好考虑的……

say:46:1620623046:1.text: If you ask me, you'd make a great professor. You get to keep doing research and share what you know. Best of both worlds!
say:46:1620623046:1.source_cn: 要我说，当老师就挺适合你！既能继续钻研学术，又能跟人分...

say:47:1620623047:1.text: Now that you put it that way... being a professor doesn't sound so bad after all...
say:47:1620623047:1.source_cn: 这么说来……做老师，似乎确实是个不错的选择……

say:48:1620623048:1.text: Ah, but young mage... if you want to be a good professor, you can't just bury yourself in your books. There's more to it than that...
say:48:1620623048:1.source_cn: 啊……年轻的魔法师，做一名好老师，可不能像你现在这样，...

say:49:1620623049:1.text: R-right. After hearing your story, I think I finally understand what really matters.
say:49:1620623049:1.source_cn: 是、是的，通过您的事，我可以感受到什么是最重要的了。

say:50:1620623050:1.text: I don't know why, but I feel... lighter somehow.
say:50:1620623050:1.source_cn: 我忽然……感到身体轻快了很多……

say:53:1620623053:1.text: You must... ugh. Never mind. Maybe that's something you'll figure out on your own, someday.
say:53:1620623053:1.source_cn: 你要……唉，算了，如何成为一名好老师，也许你会自己的答案。

say:54:1620623054:0.text: Still, thank you. All of you...

say:56:1620623055:1.text: Movan's voice grows quiet. It still sounds tired, but there's a calm in it he hasn't felt for a long while.
say:56:1620623055:1.source_cn: 莫温的声音渐渐低了下去，疲惫中夹杂着一种久违的轻松。

say:57:1620623056:1.text: His figure slowly melts into the dim light. Even the magic books in the corners, once powered by the echo's magic, crumble away like scraps of paper.
say:57:1620623056:1.source_cn: 他的身影在微光中逐渐淡去，连教室角落里那些被回声魔力驱...

say:58:1620623057:1.text: From that night on, the lecture hall of the Serene Lyceum never again echoes with that scolding voice.
say:58:1620623057:1.source_cn: 自那之后，莱希拉姆的教学楼再没有响起过那诡异而严厉的训斥声。

choice:26:0:1.text: That's what being young is about—testing your limits.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 不断触碰自己的极限，就是青春本身
choice:26:0:1.male: That's what being young is about—testing your limits.
choice:26:0:1.female: That's what being young is about—testing your limits.

say:61:1620623027:1.text: Yeah. That moment when you finally figure something out, it's the best feeling!
say:61:1620623027:1.source_cn: 没错，发现是一种喜悦！理解通向自由！

say:62:1620623028:1.text: That passion... it's a kind of magic all its own. Stronger than any spell!
say:62:1620623028:1.source_cn: 是的，狂热本身就是一种能量，比任何魔法都要强大！

choice:26:2:3.text: I get that kind of passion.
choice:26:2:3.male: I get that kind of passion.
choice:26:2:3.female: I get that kind of passion.

choice:15:0:1.text: You wanted the best for your students. That's admirable.
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 为学生着想就是好老师
choice:15:0:1.male: You wanted the best for your students. That's admirable.
choice:15:0:1.female: You wanted the best for your students. That's admirable.

say:63:1620623017:1.text: Does it? Reflection doesn't erase the harm I caused.
say:63:1620623017:1.source_cn: 可这些反省……又有什么意义呢？

choice:15:1:2.text: You've reflected on all of it. That means something.
choice:15:1:2.male: You've reflected on all of it. That means something.
choice:15:1:2.female: You've reflected on all of it. That means something.

choice:10:0:1.text: Maybe that was the real you.
choice:10:0:1.male: Maybe that was the real you.
choice:10:0:1.female: Maybe that was the real you.

say:64:1620623010:1.text: ... Maybe so. But whether it was the system or my own doing, the pressure those students felt was real, and it came from me.
say:64:1620623010:1.source_cn: ……或许吧。可不论是环境所迫，还是我自己的选择，学生承...

say:65:1620623011:1.text: That guilt stayed with me. Even now, in this state, it's still there, weighing on me.
say:65:1620623011:1.source_cn: 这份悔意，就算化作现在这副样子，也依旧压在我的心头。

choice:10:1:2.text: You became that way because of the system.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 你只是被环境逼成那样的
choice:10:1:2.male: You became that way because of the system.
choice:10:1:2.female: You became that way because of the system.

say:1:1620625001:0.text: Hey, Loran! Stop staring at your book already!
say:1:1620625001:0.source_cn: 喂，洛兰，别老盯着书看了！

say:2:1620625002:1.text: Hang on, I've been digging into this paper on teaching methods. Took forever to find, and I finally hit the part that makes it all click.
say:2:1620625002:1.source_cn: 等一下，我正琢磨一个教育问题，这篇文献找了好久，刚刚才...

say:3:1620625003:1.text: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!
say:3:1620625003:1.male: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!
say:3:1620625003:1.female: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!

say:6:1620625005:1.text: Me? Still goofing off as always.
say:6:1620625005:1.source_cn: 我挺好的，一如既往地混日子。
say:6:1620625005:1.male: Me? Still goofing off as always.
say:6:1620625005:1.female: Me? Still goofing off as always.

say:7:1620625006:0.text: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.
say:7:1620625006:0.source_cn: 至于洛兰，至少现在能按时吃饭睡觉了。
say:7:1620625006:0.male: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.
say:7:1620625006:0.female: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.

say:8:1620625007:0.text: I'm not pushing myself like before. If a student burns out, it ends up on the professor's plate too.
say:8:1620625007:0.source_cn: 影响健康的事我肯定不会再做了。毕竟学生要是出了状况，老...

say:9:1620625008:0.text: Ooh... this guy's totally changed. Used to be all about research. Now it's "education theory this," "good teaching that"—he won't shut up about it.
say:9:1620625008:0.source_cn: 呼……这小子现在变了，从之前的学术转移到教育学了，满嘴...

choice_prompt:10:1620625008.text: Ooh... this guy's totally changed. Used to be all about research. Now it's "education theory this," "good teaching that"—he won't shut up about it.
choice_prompt:10:1620625008.source_cn: 呼……这小子现在变了，从之前的学术转移到教育学了，满嘴都是这些，老师长老师短的……

say:11:1620625009:0.text: Right now? He's asking me to join him in studying... cardiac resuscitation massage. I kid you not!
say:11:1620625009:0.source_cn: 现在？这小子要我陪他去学习什么……心脏复苏按摩！

say:12:1620625011:0.text: No magic, just old-school emergency aid! I don't even get why he's so into it.
say:12:1620625011:0.source_cn: 完全不用魔法，都是原始的急救术，我真搞不懂学这个干嘛。

say:13:1620625012:1.text: Obviously, to protect my future students.
say:13:1620625012:1.source_cn: 当然是保护我未来的学生。

say:14:1620625013:1.text: What if something happens and I can't use magic? I want to be ready.
say:14:1620625013:1.source_cn: 想想看，要是遇到特殊情况，魔法用不了怎么办？

say:15:1620625014:1.text: Fair point. I should learn too... You never know when someone might faint from a ghost encounter again and need me to revive them.
say:15:1620625014:1.source_cn: 说的有道理，我也得学学，免得有人自己再被幽灵吓到，得我...

say:16:1620625015:1.text: Oh please, like you're one to talk.
say:16:1620625015:1.source_cn: 什么啊，你还好意思说别人吗？

say:17:1620625016:1.text: The two exchange a look and laugh.
say:17:1620625016:1.source_cn: 两人对视了一下，释怀地笑了。

say:18:1620625017:1.text: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.
say:18:1620625017:1.source_cn: 说起来，那段深夜里的回声，现在想想……对我来说，更像是...
say:18:1620625017:1.male: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.
say:18:1620625017:1.female: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.

say:19:1620625018:1.text: After that, I started to reflect, not just on why I study, but on what scholarship even means.
say:19:1620625018:1.source_cn: 也是那之后，我开始思考研究学术的意义，甚至是……学术本...

choice_prompt:20:1620625018.text: After that, I started to reflect, not just on why I study, but on what scholarship even means.
choice_prompt:20:1620625018.source_cn: 也是那之后，我开始思考研究学术的意义，甚至是……学术本身存在的意义。

say:21:1620625019:1.text: Well, this is just my take, but I think the point of scholarship is to open new doors. To bring the unknown into focus, and light a path forward.
say:21:1620625019:1.source_cn: 当然，这只是我的拙见——我认为学术的存在，是为了点亮另...

say:22:1620625020:1.text: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.
say:22:1620625020:1.source_cn: 而学术，也是责任。背负着共创伊索米亚更好明天的责任。
say:22:1620625020:1.male: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.
say:22:1620625020:1.female: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.

say:23:1620625021:1.text: Maybe one day, I'll stand where Professor Movan once stood, passing on everything I've learned, along with this sense of purpose, to my students.
say:23:1620625021:1.source_cn: 或许将来，我也会站在莫温老师曾伫立的讲台上，将我毕生所...

say:24:1620625022:1.text: And his lessons... I'll never forget them. Teaching isn't just about knowledge—it's about seeing each student's joy, their confusion, and helping them keep going.
say:24:1620625022:1.source_cn: 至于莫温老师的教诲，我绝不会忘记。不只是传道授业，更要...

say:25:1620625023:1.text: Alright, "Professor Loran"—your emergency aid class is starting soon! You've still got a ways to go before you're teaching for real!
say:25:1620625023:1.source_cn: 好啦，洛兰“老师”——你的急救课真要迟到了！离你正式执...

say:27:1620625025:1.text: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!
say:27:1620625025:1.male: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!
say:27:1620625025:1.female: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!

choice:20:0:1.text: And? What did you figure out?
choice:20:0:1.male: And? What did you figure out?
choice:20:0:1.female: And? What did you figure out?

choice:10:0:1.text: Where are you two headed now?
choice:10:0:1.male: Where are you two headed now?
choice:10:0:1.female: Where are you two headed now?

say:29:1620625010:1.text: Right? And now it's "let's learn cardiac resuscitation massage together!"
say:29:1620625010:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛……这会又要我陪他去学习什么……心脏复苏按摩！

choice:10:1:2.text: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 学霸认真起来是这样的
choice:10:1:2.male: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.
choice:10:1:2.female: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.

choice:5:0:1.text: So, how have you two been?
choice:5:0:1.male: So, how have you two been?
choice:5:0:1.female: So, how have you two been?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1620608002:.text: That's Banksee, isn't it? He's in trouble. We've got to help!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1620608002:.source_cn: 那个是……班克西？我们得帮帮他！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1620608002:.male: That's Banksee, isn't it? He's in trouble. We've got to help!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1620608002:.female: That's Banksee, isn't it? He's in trouble. We've got to help!
